user.title: Electricity consumption
user.description: Choose the main meter and the energy price. Consumers are added afterwards, from the integration page.

data_description.meter_power: The whole-house total. Several sensors are summed.
data_description.meter_energy: Optional but recommended: without it energy is computed from power.
data_description.contract_kw: Committed power (for example 3, 4.5 or 6 kW): used by the overload alert and the bill.
data_description.contract_kw_f3: For the Italian ARERA electric-vehicle trial: 6 kW at night (23-7), on Sundays and holidays. The overload alert follows the power valid at that time.
data_description.price_entity: For example your supplier's sensor. When missing or unavailable the fixed price is used.

error.meter_required: Choose at least one power sensor.

data_description.meter_energy: Optional but recommended: without it energy is computed from power.
data_description.contract_kw: Committed power (for example 3, 4.5 or 6 kW): used by the overload alert and the bill.
data_description.contract_kw_f3: For the Italian ARERA electric-vehicle trial: 6 kW at night (23-7), on Sundays and holidays. The overload alert follows the power valid at that time.

tariff.title: Tariff
tariff.description: Bands follow the Italian ARERA calendar: F1 Mon-Fri 8-19; F2 Mon-Fri 7-8 and 19-23, Saturday 7-23; F3 nights, Sundays and holidays. kWh per band are always counted, even with a fixed price.

data_description.price: Also used when the price entity is unavailable.
data_description.entity_f1: Optional: when set they take precedence over the prices above.

bill.title: Bill
bill.description: The items beyond the energy price: you find them on your bill or contract.

data.full_cost: Costs include transport, charges, excise and VAT

data_description.full_cost: When on, meter and consumer costs are the real billed ones (without fixed fees); otherwise energy only.

data.monthly_report: Monthly report, on the first day of the month
data.overload_alert: Alert when available power is exceeded
data.overload_minutes: Minutes above the threshold before alerting

data_description.notify_services: Notify services. The consumi_elettrici_report and consumi_elettrici_sovraccarico events are fired anyway.
data_description.overload_alert: The threshold is contract power plus 10%. The integration only alerts: it switches nothing off.

error.meter_required: Choose at least one power sensor.

user.title: New consumer
user.description: Something that draws power and has a sensor: a plug, a line, the wallbox. One of the two sensors is enough.

data_description.power_entity: Used for live power. Without an energy sensor, energy is computed from it.
data_description.energy_entity: A counter that grows over time (kWh or Wh): the most accurate source, and it brings its history.
data_description.parent: Usually the main meter. If this consumer is on a line that already has its own sensor (for example "Apartment"), choose that line: it will not be counted twice.

error.name_exists: A consumer with this name already exists.
error.sensor_required: Choose at least one sensor, power or energy.
error.parent_invalid: This choice is not possible: a line that contains other consumers cannot sit behind another one.

options.bands: Price per band F1, F2, F3

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Fills missing days from Home Assistant statistics of the energy sensors. Measured days are left untouched.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back. Empty: from last year for new sensors, ten days for the others.

send_report.name: Send report
send_report.description: Sends the monthly report now to the chosen notify services and fires the consumi_elettrici_report event.
